text: You are able to use until there's 10% usage left of my weekly claude sub
context: The owner's instruction on 2026-10-23, given with the launch commands for the rule-version-3 regrade and before any batch was dispatched. Apply quotaStopPercent=90: the controller launches no further batch once usage reaches 90%, which keeps 10% of the weekly Claude plan free. The threshold is shared by both Claude usage windows, so the 5-hour window also stops at 90% and resumes after its reset. Scope, grader, effort, session limit and the per-queue dollar caps (total $499.99) are unchanged from approval.v1.json.
